question: What comprehensive division of octads does the speaker seek to understand?
premises: The division of eight octads is the object of inquiry.
The speaker seeks to know it fully.
The knowledge is sought in an exhaustive manner.
inference: The speaker seeks to fully and exhaustively understand the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: anantathā may imply limitless detail or endless extent.
plain_english: And I wish to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
